title: HIll climb Racings 2
desc: Hill Climb Racings 2 is back, bigger, better and Its even more fun! Join millions of players from around the world in this action packed car racing game with realistic physics
howto: Mouse click or tap to play
tips: Read the next obstacle early before making a move.
Use small, steady inputs instead of overcorrecting.
Restart quickly and learn the pattern one attempt at a time.
